verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an official CLI, `gddy`, with a set-up guide. It covers the workflow from domain search through purchase to DNS management in the terminal (e.g. `gddy dns set example.com --type A`). An official agent skill lets AI coding agents install and run `gddy` commands using the user's authenticated session. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of a full command reference or machine-readable output modes for agents.
